title: Gabriel Pastro
requirements: Development of a stylized humanoid main character for an emotional narrative adventure. The character was designed to evoke a fine-art aesthetic, utilizing custom painted brushstroke patterns mimicking physical oil paints. Technical requirements mandated a black character palette with glowing emblems on the back and a specialized eyelid structure allowing programmatic blink controls.
achievements: Designed a legally independent, custom visual hero based on original reference artwork
Authored hand-painted oil brushstroke detail textures that adapt dynamically to HDRP lights
Programmed specialized 4-bone eyelid control layers to support smooth facial expressions
